description: This is a Java unit test class for the JsonParser of ThingAcknowledgement objects. It contains tests verifying parsing logic, exception handling, and immutability.

classes.name: ThingAcknowledgementJsonParserTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the JsonParser handling ThingAcknowledgement JSON objects. Contains various tests to verify correct parsing, exception handling, and class immutability.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment before each test, creating a new DittoHeaders instance and obtaining the JsonParser.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the JsonParser class is immutable.

methods.name: parseNullJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies that parsing a null JsonObject throws a NullPointerException with the correct message.

methods.name: parseValidJsonRepresentationWithPayload
methods.description: Tests parsing of a valid JsonObject representing an acknowledgement with a payload, expecting successful parsing back to an equivalent Acknowledgement object.

methods.name: parseValidJsonRepresentationWithoutPayload
methods.description: Tests parsing of a valid JsonObject representing an acknowledgement without a payload, expecting success.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutLabel
methods.description: Verifies that missing the label field results in a JsonMissingFieldException.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidLabel
methods.description: Checks that an invalid label value causes a JsonParseException with the appropriate cause.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutEntityId
methods.description: Ensures that missing entity ID field throws a JsonMissingFieldException.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidEntityId
methods.description: Tests invalid entity ID string causes a JsonParseException with the correct cause.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutEntityType
methods.description: Verifies missing entity type field triggers a JsonMissingFieldException.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithUnexpectedEntityType
methods.description: Tests that an entity type in the JSON differing from the expected triggers a JsonParseException.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutStatusCode
methods.description: Checks that absence of status code in JSON results in a JsonMissingFieldException.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithUnknownStatusCode
methods.description: Verifies that an unsupported status code causes a JsonParseException.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures missing DittoHeaders field results in a JsonMissingFieldException.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests that invalid DittoHeaders value in JSON causes a JsonParseException.
